Hi all,

Today at D-RUG I'll be giving a short talk I'm calling "Speeding up R Code for Busy People".  I'll be focusing on the blunt instruments for speeding up code that take less programming time.

We'll meet at the usual place and time: Wickson 2124, 1-3PM.

Noam
